posts.text: Weekend update out. Zelensky has been on a tweet storm lately, and it has been illuminating. posts.text:
The failure to understand the limits of Russian military power before the 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine was until that time the greatest failure in modern strategic analysis.

The failure to understand the limits of US military power since February 2026 might be worse.
